verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at help.pulley.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the help center. Several cited help articles also resolve as per-article .md URLs, giving agents a markdown-friendly way to read the docs. Coverage is limited to help-center content: the root docs-md path returned 404 and no OpenAPI or developer docs were found. Missing for 10: first-party documentation or announcement of the agent-oriented docs, an llms-full.txt or broader developer/API coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
